items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 29:1
items.html: Zeir [small] is a term meaning small. And he is called this because of the Gevurot and the judgments revealed in him, and he is therefore likened to a small one, since it is the way of the small one to be cruel and quick-tempered, while the more one grows the more settled one becomes in one's mind. Therefore the revelation of mercy is called by the name old age and gray hair. (Items 82 and 83).
